documents.title: Prairie County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 72 pages. Amounts are the 2026 REQUEST (the budget adopted by reference in Ordinance 2025-16, passed 12/23/25) column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
